extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

For 11 to 65 years of age, antigen or antibody screening for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection (CPT code 87389) IS REIMBURSABLE.

Screening for an HIV infection with an antigen or antibody combination assay (CPT code 87389) or with a rapid antibody test (CPT code 87806) IS REIMBURSABLE for all ages when any of the following conditions are met:

About to begin or actively receiving pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP)

History of previous or concurrent sexually transmitted infection (STI), hepatitis or tuberculosis

For all situations described above, HIV testing (CPT code 87389, CPT code 87806) IS REIMBURSABLE no more than one test every 90 days.

HIV genotyping or phenotyping (CPT code 87901, CPT code 87903, CPT code 87904, CPT code 87906) IS REIMBURSABLE for patients with HIV.

Drug susceptibility phenotype prediction using genotypic comparison to known genotypic or phenotypic database (CPT code 87900, CPT code 0219U) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.
